settings.title: Nakuru, Kenya: DE Africa GeoMAD H1 2024 vs its Sentinel-2 scenes

findings.text: 21% of composite pixels come from 12 scenes that fail the outlier screen.
The largest single scene (S2B_36MZE_20240131_0_L2A) supplies 20% of the composite; the composite behaves like 11.4 equal scenes.

layers.NCLEAR: clear observations in the period (Francini criterion 1; FORCE INF NUM)
layers.MAX_GAP: longest stretch with no clear observation, days, including the period edges
layers.SRC_SCENE: 1-based scene number the composite pixel came from (0 = none); proxy for median composites
layers.SRC_DOY: day of year of the source observation (FORCE INF DOY)
layers.DOYD: days between source observation and target date (Francini criterion 4; FORCE INF DOYD)
layers.SRC_SENSOR: sensor of the source observation: 1 Landsat, 2 Sentinel-2 (FORCE INF SEN)
layers.LANDSAT_SHARE: share of the pixel's clear observations that are Landsat
layers.SRC_SCENE_SHARE: share of the whole area that came from this pixel's source scene (dominance)
layers.SRC_OUTLIER: 1 if the source observation is a robust outlier in the visible bands, 0 if not, 255 unknown
